title: In Search of Convenience
statement: The task is to output any lattice point on the circle of radius R centred at a given integer point (x0, y0), where the centre's coordinates lie in [-10, 10], R is at most 25, and the answer's coordinates are unrestricted. The key observation is constructive: the axis-aligned point (x0 + R, y0) is always exactly R away, so each test is answered in O(1).
